items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: like Hulk tries to play ragtime

ctx.x: Yeah. So were you going to ask some more about Oscar?

Bill you talking about you hear these guys playing ragtime you know like Hulk tries to play ragtime and I heard some guys out on the coast you know like Boyd Owls or those guys. Mickey used to really play fine ragtime piano. We used to play a lot of those rags you know like what you call them? Maple leaf.
